column1: # furniture-overrides.tsv — live nodes that ARE furniture though their name and type say genuine. HAND-MAINTAINED; coverage.mjs reads it.
# live/*.tsv records a node's type, size, visibility and name, never its children or text, so a 1080-wide cover poster
# with no UI text, a vector illustration or an empty frame reads as a genuine frame. Earlier lanes READ these nodes and
# filed them `furniture` in the status rows; each row here cites that reading, and coverage.mjs then agrees with it.
# It moves the denominator, so it fails closed: a row without a Figma file key, a node id, a date and evidence citing
# a file:line or a commit is refused and the node stays in; and a row applies only while the node's own newest
# status row still says `furniture`, so re-filing the node in a status table switches its override off.
# Deliberately NOT listed (no recorded read, only a name): 10401-6360, 10758-20769, 11602-21869 (Mines cards on other
# games' pages), 2452-9383 and 2459-9386 (video cuts for an onboarding slot). A board whose own name rejects it
# (11345-146431 'Truncated ALT - NOT recommended') is a rule in coverage.mjs (AUTHOR_REJECTED), not a row here.
# Added 2026-09-24 (wave 67, w67-cat-verdicts) from w67-cat-status-b's and w67-cat-status-a's furniture findings.
